purpose: A value as one segment of a frame's save path. Shared by the app's naming pattern (ImagingService._sanitizePathComponent, read by packages/skotiq_core/test/services/imaging_service_naming_tokens_test.dart) and a run's save template (path_segment in native/skotiq_native/sequencer/src/node/instructions/expose.rs), so manual and sequence frames name the same target the same way.
